# Class: Digest 


_One checksum of an artifact, keyed by the function that produced it. Collected on ``Provenance.digest``, whose collection KEY is the function name — BEP028 takes the names ``MD5``, ``SHA1``, ``SHA-256`` and the rest of that list, and allows an arbitrary label otherwise. Keyed rather than a bare string so an artifact can carry several digests and a reader knows which function to check with._
